name: Perricoota
terms: Australia's Geographical Indications nest in three levels: zones, the regions inside them, and subregions inside those.

blurb.text: A region in the Big Rivers zone of New South Wales, planted above all to Merlot (31 percent), Petite Sirah (20) and Cabernet Sauvignon (18). Big Rivers has four regions, including Murray Darling and Riverina.
